specs.SuspendKTask::suspend_by_id_ic: suspend_by_id_ic With (sg : StableGlobalState) (before : VarGlobalState) Require id < 65536 && os_inv(sg, before) Ensure exists (found : Z) (after : VarGlobalState), found != 0 && get_task_with_idnode_success(sg, before, id, found) && ktask_suspend_step(found, before, __return, after) && os_inv(sg, after)
specs.DoubleLinkListInsertNodeBefore::dispatch: dispatch_case With {A} (storeA: Z -> A -> Assertion) (head: Z) (nodes: list(DL_Node A)) (inserted_data: A) Require dll_insert_anchor(head, nodes, linklist) && linklist_node != 0 && store_dll(storeA, head, nodes) * storeA(linklist_node, inserted_data) * occupy_dll_node(linklist_node) Ensure store_dll( storeA, head, dll_insert_before_dispatch( head, nodes, linklist, Build_DL_Node(inserted_data, linklist_node)))
specs.DoubleLinkListInsertNodeAfter::dispatch_: dispatch_case With {A} (storeA: addr -> A -> Assertion) (nodes: list(DL_Node A)) (a: A) (head: addr) Require dll_insert_anchor(head, nodes, linklist) && linklist_node != 0 && store_dll(storeA, head, nodes) * storeA(linklist_node, a) * occupy_dll_node(linklist_node) Ensure store_dll( storeA, head, dll_insert_after_dispatch( head, nodes, linklist, Build_DL_Node(a, linklist_node)))
specs.LinklistSuspend::semaphore_ic: semaphore_ic With (sg : StableGlobalState) (before : VarGlobalState) (sem : Z) (waiting : list Z) Require list == semaphore_pending_head(sem) && semaphore_pending_nodes(sem, before, map(sched_link_node, waiting)) && linklist_suspend_admissible(task, flag, before) && os_inv(sg, before) Ensure exists after, linklist_suspend_step(sem, task, flag, before, __return, after) && os_inv(sg, after)
specs.LinklistSuspend::semaphore_prio_ic: semaphore_prio_ic <= semaphore_ic With (sg : StableGlobalState) (before : VarGlobalState) (sem : Z) (waiting : list Z) Require list == semaphore_pending_head(sem) && flag == 1 && semaphore_pending_nodes(sem, before, map(sched_link_node, waiting)) && linklist_suspend_admissible(task, flag, before) && os_inv(sg, before) Ensure __return == 0 && exists after, linklist_suspend_prio(sem, task, before, after) && os_inv(sg, after)
